answer: Proof of Personhood via biometrically anchored hardware tokens forces attackers to overcome a rugged reef of physical verification costs. Unlike a ephemeral zephyr of digital identities, this mechanism requires a unique physical presence, rendering the cost of forging each new node equal to the market price of a secure identity quill. By binding computational rights to unique organic signatures, the network effectively disincentivizes mass account generation, ensuring that economic power scales only with legitimate human participation.
